summary: Verified Task 9 (New Claim flow) and Task 12 (Share Contact button) on the live Expo web preview as MechanicLTZ@gmail.com. Task 9 PASSES end-to-end: NEW CLAIM button opens the START A CLAIM modal, claim-search-input renders, claim-pick-<toolId> rows are tappable, tapping a row routes to /tool/<id>?startClaim=1, the EDIT REPAIR INFO sheet AUTO-OPENS without any 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' or other red-screen / pageerror, and pressing SAVE navigates back to /claims as expected. Task 12 PARTIAL PASS (web): the SHARE pill (testID=share-borrower-btn) is present on /borrower/<id> next to EDIT and DELETE, and tapping it does NOT crash. However, on RN-Web the Alert.alert(title, message, [Share / Save / Cancel]) used by handleShare() does not render a multi-button action sheet — RN-Web's Alert implementation ignores the buttons array, so no Share/Save options appear on web. This is a known web limitation (also documented in the original request); on native iOS/Android the three-button sheet will render correctly. No code change required for the testing-on-web target.

integration_issues.flow: Task 12 share-borrower action sheet on RN-Web
integration_issues.issue: RN-Web's Alert.alert ignores the buttons array, so 'Share (text / email)', 'Save to Phone Contacts', 'Cancel' do NOT appear on web preview. Button itself is wired up correctly and does not crash. Native iOS/Android Expo Go / dev-client will render the action sheet correctly. The request itself acknowledges this caveat — flagging here for completeness only.

action_items: Task 9: No further action required — flow works end-to-end, no hooks-order error.

Task 12: Optional polish — on RN-Web, replace Alert.alert with an in-app Modal/ActionSheet so the three Share/Save/Cancel options are visible in the web preview too. Native behavior is already correct.

claims.tsx: newClaim modal state, async listTools fetch in openNewClaim, claim-pick-<id> testIDs, and router.push('/tool/<id>?startClaim=1') are all in place; UX is responsive and the modal closes on pick.
